usedFor: GoSweetSpot handles shipping rates, and “Create Rate” and “Create or Update StockSize” keep them current.

bestTemplate.name: “Receive Incoming Message” in Quo, then “Create Rate” in GoSweetSpot
bestTemplate.why: It records a new shipping rate in GoSweetSpot, so quoting starts from saved figures.

watchOut: “Create or Update StockSize” can change an existing size, so check the entry before it runs.
